clauses.reason: Adopts the Administrator findings and approves the code subject to all five conditions; approval has prospective consequences, not proven spent on signing.

Adds both a recurring duty on producers to furnish statistical information and a duty to transmit collected reports as the Administrator directs. No performance or extinction of either duty is proved.

Adds presidential power to appoint up to three Industrial Board members in addition to or substitution for the code-authority members. Held EO 6299 corrects six to five; amendment continues the provision as corrected, not a repeal.

Approves Schedule A and reserves supplemental rate approval before code effectiveness. No held code effective-date text or full schedule establishes the temporal boundary; EO 6299 exercises rate approval without ending the parent as a whole.
Eliminates article V(b) while expressly preserving non-disapproval of the Administrator/general-counsel joint statement in Schedule B. This qualification is not proof that no residual effects remain.
Moves the personnel exception from article II to article III by strike and insert. The resulting code continues as amended; the amendment is not cessation of the parent.
